info.name: Placement Prep API
info.description:
Every REST endpoint of the placement-prep backend, including the role-based access rules: each restricted endpoint is called once by a role that may use it and once by one that may not.

Run the folders in order - later requests use the tokens and ids earlier ones save. Set baseUrl if the backend is not on http://localhost:8081. File uploads read sample-job-description.pdf and sample-resume.pdf from this folder.

Each run registers a new postman.<timestamp>@cse.nits.ac.in student, which is left in the database (there is no endpoint to delete an account).

9. Recruiters
item.description: A recruiter is a company hiring contact, added by the admin with a company email. They post drives and review applicants, but only for drives they posted themselves: anyone else's drive is a 404, exactly like a drive that does not exist. They are not a student, so applying, resume feedback, the assistant and job-description search all answer 403.

10. Promotion and clean-up
item.description: Staffing the cell is the admin's call alone. The student's delete is refused before the promotion; after it, the same token is a coordinator's, because the backend re-reads the role from the database on every request.
